mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", department AS "department", COALESCE(is_admin, 0) = 1 AS "admin" FROM employees WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT f.id AS "id", f.parent_id AS "parentId", f.name AS "name", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = f.created_by LIMIT 1), f.created_by) AS "createdBy", f.created_at AS "createdAt", f.kind AS "kind", f.department AS "department", f.owner_id AS "ownerId", e.name AS "ownerName", f.lock_hash AS "lockHash", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = f.lock_by LIMIT 1), f.lock_by) AS "lockBy", f.lock_at AS "lockAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment a WHERE a.scope = 'document' AND a.ref_id = CAST(f.id AS TEXT)) AS "fileCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_folder c WHERE c.parent_id = f.id) AS "childCount" FROM document_folder f LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = f.owner_id ORDER BY f.parent_id NULLS FIRST, f.name
SELECT folder_id AS "folderId", COALESCE(expires_at, '') AS "expiresAt" FROM document_share WHERE to_employee_id = #{toId} AND folder_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_folder (parent_id, name, kind, department, owner_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{parentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{name}, #{kind, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{department, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE document_folder SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.attachment_id AS "attachmentId", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM document_share s JOIN attachment a ON a.id = s.attachment_id WHERE a.scope = 'document' AND a.ref_id = #{folderId} GROUP BY s.attachment_id
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_share (attachment_id, folder_id, to_employee_id, shared_by, shared_by_name, note, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{attachmentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{folderId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{toEmployeeId}, #{sharedBy}, #{sharedByName}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiresAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", department AS "department" FROM employees WHERE id <> #{me} ORDER BY department NULLS LAST, name
SELECT DISTINCT department FROM employees WHERE department IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(department) <> '' ORDER BY department

SELECT s.id AS "id", s.attachment_id AS "attachmentId", s.shared_by_name AS "sharedByName", s.note AS "note", s.expires_at AS "expiresAt", s.created_at AS "createdAt", a.orig_name AS "origName", a.size_bytes AS "sizeBytes", FALSE AS "folder" FROM document_share s JOIN attachment a ON a.id = s.attachment_id WHERE s.to_employee_id = #{me} AND s.attachment_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.id AS "id", s.folder_id AS "folderId", s.shared_by_name AS "sharedByName", s.note AS "note", s.expires_at AS "expiresAt", s.created_at AS "createdAt", f.name AS "origName", TRUE AS "folder", (f.lock_hash IS NOT NULL) AS "locked" FROM document_share s JOIN document_folder f ON f.id = s.folder_id WHERE s.to_employee_id = #{me} AND s.folder_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.id AS "id", s.attachment_id AS "attachmentId", s.folder_id AS "folderId", s.to_employee_id AS "toEmployeeId", s.note AS "note", s.expires_at AS "expiresAt", s.created_at AS "createdAt", e.name AS "toName", COALESCE(a.orig_name, f.name) AS "origName", (s.folder_id IS NOT NULL) AS "folder" FROM document_share s LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = s.to_employee_id LEFT JOIN attachment a ON a.id = s.attachment_id LEFT JOIN document_folder f ON f.id = s.folder_id WHERE s.shared_by = #{me} AND (a.id IS NOT NULL OR f.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
SELECT shared_by FROM document_share WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM chat_rooms WHERE dm_key = #{dmKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (room_type, name, dm_key, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('dm', NULL, #{dmKey}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (dm_key) WHERE dm_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO chat_room_members (room_id, employee_id, employee_name, joined_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{joinedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO chat_messages (room_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, created_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room_members SET last_read_message_id = #{messageId} WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
